caketext_translator.model.incomplete: Still missing in the model folder: %s
caketext_translator.model.bad_file: %s isn't the expected file; download it again from the download page
caketext_translator.marker.machine_note: Made by a small model on your PC, so it may be wrong.
caketext_translator.option.enabled.tip: Show server text in your language.
caketext_translator.option.machine.tip: Lines no string file translates yet are translated by %s in the background. They show in English until it's done.
caketext_translator.option.quality.tip: Best: about 0.6 s a line, closest to the full model. Fast: about 0.1 s a line, a bit rougher. Lines are translated once and remembered.
caketext_translator.option.markers.tip: An icon on translated text: a book for string translations, a chip for the model. In chat, hover it to see the source and the original.
caketext_translator.option.tooltip_foote: A line at the bottom of item tooltips saying where the translations came from.
caketext_translator.option.model_install: Checks the 4 files, converts them to an int8 file of about 75 MB and deletes the originals. Uses about 110 MB of memory while loaded.
caketext_translator.option.model_page.ti: Opens opus-mt-en-zh (Helsinki-NLP, Apache-2.0) on Hugging Face, at the version this mod was tested with. Download these 4 files (about %2$s MB in all): %1$s. The mod itself downloads nothing.
Put the 4 downloaded files here: %s. Keep their names.
caketext_translator.surfaces.title: Where to translate
caketext_translator.command.model_instal: Installing the model from the model folder in the background. /cttranslate status shows progress.
caketext_translator.command.test_none: Not in any string file, and the model isn't ready.
caketext_translator.command.test_queued: Not in any string file; asking the model…
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.caketext-: Translates server text from string files; strings not translated yet go to a local opus-mt model, a local LLM server or an online service. An icon shows where each translation came from.
caketext_translator.option.display.tip: Tooltips: Translation, Both (translation, then the original in grey) or Original (translation in grey below). Scoreboard, titles, boss bars, nameplates and the action bar show the translation unless set to Original.
caketext_translator.option.player_chat.t: What other players say is translated by the engine, but only when it runs on this PC or your home network (never an online service). Only the message: channel tags, rank and name stay as they are. These translations are kept in memory only, never written to disk.
caketext_translator.option.player_chat_d: Original (default): what they wrote; hover it to see the translation. Translation: hover to see what they wrote. Both: the translation, then the original in grey.
caketext_translator.engine.title: Translation engine
caketext_translator.option.engine_type.t: What translates lines no string file has. opus-mt: small model built into the mod (download below). Local server: a bigger model you run yourself, e.g. Hunyuan-MT-7B in Ollama; better translations, needs a GPU with about 8 GB. Online service: Google, DeepL, Microsoft or LibreTranslate with your own API key; good translations without a GPU, but the text goes to that company, which bills per character. Player chat never goes online.
caketext_translator.option.protocol.tip: Ollama: default address http://127.0.0.1:11434. OpenAI-compatible: llama.cpp llama-server (start it with --jinja, port 8080) or LM Studio (port 1234).
caketext_translator.option.server_url.ti: Where the server listens. On this PC or your home network it translates player chat too; any other address gets server text only.
As the server names it. For Hunyuan-MT-7B in Ollama run: ollama pull hf.co/mradermacher/Hunyuan-MT-7B-GGUF:Q4_K_M (4.3 GB). Hunyuan-MT is under the Tencent Hunyuan Community License, which doesn't cover the EU, UK or South Korea.
Saves these settings and asks the server now. The status line above shows the answer.
caketext_translator.server.no_model: connected, but it has no model %s
caketext_translator.option.item_names.ti: Off (default): the first tooltip line, the item's name, stays as the server sends it, the name other players, the trade market and wikis use. Lore and stats below it are still translated.
Server messages in chat. Original (default): the message as sent; hover it to see the translation. Translation: hover to see the original. Both: the translation, then the original in grey.
caketext_translator.option.cache_clear.t: Forgets everything the current engine translated (its _machine file), so lines are translated again, e.g. after a better engine or prompt.
caketext_translator.command.model_folder: Model folder opened. Download these files into it: %s. Download page: %s
caketext_translator.option.online_servic: Google Cloud Translation, DeepL, Microsoft Translator (Azure) or LibreTranslate. Every line to translate (server text, tooltips, wiki pages) is sent to that service; player chat never is. Services bill per character: a game session stops after %s characters (onlineCharLimit in translator.json, 0 = no limit).
caketext_translator.option.online_key.ti: Your own key from the service's console. Shown as stars, stored only in config/caketext/translator.json on this PC. DeepL Free keys end in :fx.
caketext_translator.option.online_region: The region of your Translator resource, e.g. westeurope. Leave it empty for a global resource.
caketext_translator.option.online_url.ti: A LibreTranslate server: libretranslate.com (needs a key) or one you run yourself.
caketext_translator.option.server_key.ti: For online OpenAI-compatible services (OpenAI, DeepSeek…): sent as a Bearer token. Leave it empty for a server on this PC. Player chat only goes to a server on this PC or your home network.
caketext_translator.online.limit: %s: stopped at this session's limit of %s characters
caketext_translator.online.paused: %s: rate limit reached, trying again in a minute
caketext_translator.option.tooltip_alt.t: Alt shows original: tooltips are translated, hold Alt to see the original. Alt shows translation: tooltips stay as the server sends them, hold Alt to translate; nothing is sent to the engine until you do. Off: Alt does nothing.
